nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-to-oily skin report a matte, non-greasy finish that controls shine without an oily mess, though one with very oily skin suggests setting it with powder to avoid shine later in the day.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including very dry skin, report strong all-day hydration, though a few still feel some dryness during the day and layer another moisturizer underneath.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it hydrates without making oily areas worse and gives a glow rather than shine, even in winter.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation thanks to the non-comedogenic, hypoallergenic formula, though one with dry and sensitive skin notes a slight tingling or burning sensation lasting about five minutes after application.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with very dry skin, report strong all-day hydration and a plumper feel; a few say their skin still feels dry after application and layer another moisturizer underneath, or find the added SPF gives a tacky rather than hydrating finish.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with acne-prone or combination-oily skin, report no new breakouts and a healthier-looking complexion, but one reviewer describes a severe breakout that was still ongoing a month after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin mostly report a matte, non-greasy finish that controls shine, though a minority find it leaves their face feeling heavy, oily or shiny by the end of the day.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with acne-prone skin believes the moisturizer has been healing her moisture barrier.

As a person with dry and sensitive skin I rate this product 4/5 stars. I love how moisturizing it is and how easy it is to apply. I find that it sinks it quite quickly and lays well under makeup. However due to my sensitive skin, I found that this product causes a very slight tingly/burning sensation that lasts about 5 minutes after application. I do love everything else about it but I do wish it was more sensitive skin friendly. I will continue to use it but I would be cautious if you have sensitive skin.

I thought this was very hydrating but it felt decently thick on my face. I usually go for something a little lighter on my face so that is my only note that I wish it wasn't as heavy on my face. I would recommend those with drier skin than mine to try out this product because i do have combo to oily skin.
best product for my acne-prone skin. makes my skin glowy and i think it's been healing my moisture barrier

extraits.titre: protects skin without feeling heavy or greasy
extraits.texte: I really enjoy using the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer SPF 50 because it combines hydration and sun protection in one step. The texture is lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly into my skin without leaving a heavy white cast, which is a big plus for daily wear. It layers well under makeup and keeps my skin feeling soft and plump throughout the day thanks to the hyaluronic acid. The pump packaging is convenient and hygienic, and the product has a fresh, clean scent that isn't overpowering. I appreciate that it provides broad-spectrum SPF 50 protection while still feeling like a moisturizer rather than a sunscreen. My only small note is that if you have very oily skin, you may prefer to set it with powder to avoid shine later in the day, but overall, it's an excellent multitasking product.

I think Neutrogena Hydro Boost Moisturizer with SPF 50 is a really good product.I like how light weight it feels on my skin.My skin feels more hydrated now and i have dry skin so i am happy that i found a product that is actually helping with that.It has made my skin feel alot more smoother. Neutrogena is definitely a brand that i trust because they make good quality products!I also like the size of the bottle it's portable so i can carry it in my bag if i want too.
